visual.general_description: Two rows of three grayscale axial brain MRI slices (rows labelled A and B) on a black background.
visual.detailed_description: A 2-by-3 grid of axial brain MRI slices on a black background. The first row is labelled with a white A and the second row with a white B at the upper left. In each row the left image is a diffusion-type slice without a visible skull, the middle image a slice with the full head outline and bright skull surroundings, and the right image a slice with the head outline and dark ventricles. Row B has brighter signal in the posterior occipital regions of the middle image and a small ring-shaped bright oval structure at the anterior scalp of the right image. No arrows, scale bars, text or patient identifiers are visible other than the two letters.

panels.general_description: Top row of three grayscale axial brain MRI slices on a black background, with a white letter A at the upper left.
panels.detailed_description: Three axial head images are arranged left to right on a black background; a white letter A sits at the upper left of the row. The left image has no skull outline visible and shows brighter regions in the anterior frontal cortex and in the deep gray-matter area. The middle image shows the full head outline with bright skull-surrounding scalp, a bright thin cortical ribbon, small dark ventricles and brighter deep gray structures. The right image shows the head outline with a bright rim around the skull, the lateral ventricles as dark spaces and a mostly uniform gray brain without obvious bright foci or text. No arrows, scale bars, patient text or burned-in labels are visible.
